architecture_decisions.decision: CI-only Ed25519 test keys are not a production trust root
Read-only verification may advance a separate audit checkpoint; it must never write business ledgers
An accepted=true echo from checkpointStore is insufficient proof of durability or serializability
V3.2-99 revocation overlay must remain mandatory after V3.2-98 success
Per-domain versions and equal revocation watermarks do not prove a shared causal snapshot
Student is primary; family is only linked for actual siblings
Immutable order, receipt, payment, SaleEvent, lesson and compensation history

next_stage: V3.2-106: contract-driven isolated PostgreSQL checkpoint prototype only after independent test DB details and owner are available; otherwise implement stronger non-production DB integration test harness without touching existing production schemas
